content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The NOWPayments digital store setup offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure that bypasses traditional payment gateways, allowing creators to receive crypto payments directly, without relying on intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal, which are often restricted in certain regions. This infrastructure is built on free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, providing a scalable and secure solution for digital commerce.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your NOWPayments digital store, you need to have a clear understanding of your target audience, the digital products you want to sell, and the cryptocurrency payment options you want to offer. You also need to set up a NOWPayments account, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana, with transaction fees averaging under $0.10 and fractions of a cent, respectively.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you need to integrate NOWPayments with your digital store, using webhooks to automate payment verification and product delivery. This can be done using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which provide a scalable and secure backend logic for your digital commerce stack. You also need to set up a file storage solution, like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to store and deliver your digital products.
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live with your NOWPayments digital store and start processing transactions. The first transaction is a crucial step, as it tests the entire infrastructure, from payment verification to product delivery. With NOWPayments, you can receive crypto payments directly, without relying on intermediaries, and with a 0.5% fee structure, you can keep more of your earnings.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital store grows, you need to scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and transactions. This can be done by optimizing your backend logic, using caching and content delivery networks (CDNs) to improve performance, and scaling your file storage solution to handle larger volumes of digital products. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can get instant access to all the tools and templates you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, you need to set up a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your digital store, using webhooks to automate payment verification and product delivery. With NOWPayments, you can receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana, with transaction fees averaging under $0.10 and fractions of a cent, respectively.

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, worth $348 separately. This kit provides everything you need to get started with NOWPayments and start receiving crypto payments for your digital products.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your NOWPayments digital store, follow these steps: set up a NOWPayments account, integrate it with your digital store, set up a file storage solution, configure your backend logic, test your payment and delivery pipeline, and go live with your store.
